 vanquished him in fight after a long struggle. The monkey-chief thereupon
 presented it along with his daughter to Kṛṣṇa; see जाम्बवत्. Kṛṣṇa
 then gave the jewel back to its proper owner Satrājit, who out of gratitude
 presented it along with his daughter Satyabhāmā to him. Afterwards when

 the instigation of a Yādava named Akrūra who desired the jewel for himself,
 killed Satrājit and gave it to Akrūra. Śatadhanvan was afterwards killed
